page0.text:
I should take it easy and relax after a meal.
Brainpower gets diverted to digestion after a meal anyway, and above all, I like having tea after I eat.
I feel bad for doing this while the other two are washing dishes, but Saber and Sakura seem to be getting along in the kitchen.

page1.text: They don't have anything in common to talk about, so working on house chores together is building trust.

page2.text:
"Those two get along pretty well, huh?"
I watch them while I relax in the living room.
I turn on the TV, which shows the typical daytime programming for housewives.
I let the atmosphere soothe my body and mind, and simply rest without doing anything else.

page3.text:
After my break, I feel much better.
My fever seems to have been due to fatigue, so I'm back to normal after resting for half a day.

page4.text:
"Shirou, will you use the rest of the afternoon to train?"
I nod at Saber.

page5.text:
Even though I've just gotten over an illness, I don't want to waste time.
I can't improve my magecraft in a few days, but I can work on my combat skills.
Having Saber train me until dinner should be a good use of my time.
